placements.role: Provides data-center switches, routers and high-performance optics for AI training and inference networks.

role_evidence.claim: Cisco's 2025 annual report says it provides routers, switches and high-performance optics to power AI training and inference workloads.

business_summary: Cisco Systems, Inc. is the incumbent enterprise networking vendor, diversifying its switch, router and optics lines toward AI training and inference workloads while its legacy enterprise-networking base still dominates revenue. It sits on the networking-optics link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: Cisco's own 2025 Form 10-K states directly that it provides routers, switches and high-performance optics to power AI training and inference workloads, a first-party VERIFIED claim rather than a third-party ranking, though the filing does not break out AI-specific revenue.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for CISCO-SYSTEMS carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/CSCO.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-07-26 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (56654000000 / 51557000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-07-30 to fiscal year ended 2025-07-26.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 11760000000 divided by Revenues 56654000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-07-26, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 14193000000 divided by net income 10180000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-07-26, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 14193000000 less capital expenditure 905000000, divided by revenue 56654000000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-07-26 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 12288000000 (total debt 19371000000 as of 2026-04-25 less cash 7083000000 as of 2026-04-25) divided by an EBITDA proxy 12460000000 (operating income 11760000000 plus depreciation 700000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-07-26).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CSCO.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 6 (state MIDDLING) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/CSCO.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CSCO.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.62, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/CSCO.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 435322800000.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 3960000000 (as of 2025-07-26) multiplied by the close 109.93 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/CSCO.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CSCO.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 435322800000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-07-26 revenue 56654000000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CSCO.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 435322800000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-07-26 GAAP net income 10180000000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CSCO.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 447610800000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-07-26 revenue 56654000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 447610800000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 13288000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.2115, '7': 0.1614, '10': 0.1254}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: networking-optics is chain-heat CROWDED, and Cisco is one of the most widely held and covered technology names in any index, AI-linked or not.

Cisco's revenue base is overwhelmingly legacy enterprise networking; the AI-linked share of the $56.7B fiscal 2025 revenue figure used here is not disclosed, so this profile cannot isolate the AI-specific growth rate from the whole.

catalysts.claim: Cisco's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K states it provides routers, switches and high-performance optics to power AI training and inference workloads, a first-party disclosure of the exact link role.

Net debt to EBITDA of 0.99x and an FCF margin of 23.5% show a balance sheet and cash-generation profile with ample room to keep investing in AI-linked product lines without external financing pressure.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json

risks.claim: Three-year revenue CAGR is only 3.2%, the slowest in the networking-optics batch; Cisco's overall growth is diluted by a much larger legacy enterprise book than any of the pure-optics names carry.
risks.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CSCO.json

risks.claim: The AI-specific role is stated qualitatively in the 10-K without a revenue split, so the un-crowded premise for Cisco specifically rests on a much smaller and unquantified slice of a very large, already-covered company.

data_gaps: No disclosed AI-specific revenue split exists in the cited 10-K passage; the exposure_summary.disclosed_revenue_exposure is NULL for this reason.

No data/edgar/docs/CSCO.json filing (the full text behind the cited 10-K URL) is on disk this run, so only the mapping's own quoted claim backs the VERIFIED catalyst and risk above; a verbatim earnings-quote check was not possible.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the networking-optics link's zero-coverage gap. Retained at O2: every canonical metric is sourced with no NULLs, but the AI-linked exposure is qualitative and diluted inside a much larger, already-crowded legacy business, so it is not a strong un-crowded candidate on its own.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.
